project: Train a small intent classifier on the HelpDesk-Intents data and measure its accuracy on the held-out test split.
reported_result: The distil-small intent classifier reaches 91.4% accuracy on the 5,000-example held-out test split.

agents.task: Train the intent classifier on the training split.
Fold the October annotation batch into the data pool and regenerate the train, validation and test splits.
Evaluate the trained classifier on the test split and write the results table.
